en-US.title: Placebo: Supplement Tracker
en-US.subtitle: Test your nootropics for real
en-US.description:
Does your supplement actually do anything? Placebo finds out, on you.

Most of what you take was chosen from a TikTok, a forum thread or a friend's stack. Placebo runs a small, randomized experiment on one supplement and tells you if it moved your numbers, did nothing, or made things worse.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick one goal and one supplement you already have.
• Placebo builds a randomized schedule: some days you take it, some days you don't. A coin flip picks the days, not your mood.
• Each day, a 90-second check-in: a reaction-time test, a quick memory task and three sliders.
• After 3 to 4 weeks, your verdict compares your on days with your off days: measurable improvement, no meaningful effect, measured worse, or not enough data yet. With the range, in plain units.
• The verdict leans on timed tests, not just how you feel, because knowing which days are on can color how you rate them.

BUILT SO YOU FINISH
• A countdown to your verdict date from day one.
• Daily quests, streaks and badges.
• A home-screen widget and a Live Activity for today's check-in.

APPLE HEALTH
Connect Apple Health and Placebo reads your sleep, resting heart rate and heart rate variability, then compares each night to the dose the day before. Read-only: Placebo never writes to Health, and Health data never leaves your phone.

THE LIBRARY
Plain-English profiles of nearly 80 popular nootropics and supplements: what they claim, what the research actually shows, safety notes, and links to the studies.

FREE REACTION TEST
Not ready to run an experiment? The reaction test is free, no sign-up.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. Your experiment data, scores and Health data stay on your device. We can't see them.

PLACEBO PRO
Running an experiment needs Placebo Pro, with a free trial for new subscribers. Choose yearly or monthly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm after the trial. Your subscription renews automatically unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings. If notifications are on, Placebo reminds you 2 days before a trial ends.

Placebo is a personal measurement tool, not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition, and it doesn't tell you what to take. Talk to a doctor before starting any supplement, especially if you take prescription medication, are pregnant, or have a health condition.
